author: IsraelSGarcia
text: Hey everyone! We've just integrated a new community comment system powered by Giscus across the entire Black Souls Database! You can now share builds, tips, and strategies, or ask questions directly on the page of any skill, weapon, or item by simply signing in with your GitHub account. Check out the brand-new 'Recent Activity' feed to see what others are discussing, and don't hesitate to leave your own comments to help build our community—if the new features don't show up immediately, just press Ctrl + F5 (or Cmd + Shift + R on Mac) to refresh your cache!
